title: Script
summary: A server-side script: runs on the server, can touch everything authoritative (DataStores, ServerStorage, all players), and is invisible/inaccessible to clients.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.description: When true, the script does not run.

properties.name: RunContext
properties.description: Luau-era addition: can retarget a Script to client or shared contexts (Enum.RunContext.Client/Server/Shared). Default is Server.

details.heading: Where Scripts run
details.body: Scripts run wherever they're parented within the server-visible DataModel — but convention (and safety) says ServerScriptService, workspace, or ServerStorage-adjacent containers. Scripts inside ReplicatedStorage also run on the server.

details.heading: What server code can do that client code can't
details.body: Read/write DataStores, use ServerStorage, see every Player's authoritative state, use HttpService freely, create authoritative gameplay. The server is the source of truth.

explanation.whatItIs: The 'authority' script type. It runs on Roblox's server for your game: it sees everything, decides everything official, and exploiters cannot touch its code.
explanation.whyItExists: Someone has to be in charge: validating actions, storing data, running rounds. That someone is server code.
whenToUse: Game systems: rounds, economy, damage, saving
Anything touching DataStores, MarketplaceService receipts, HttpService
Validating and applying every client request
whenNotToUse: UI interaction, camera, input, sounds — that's LocalScript territory
Anything that must react instantly to local input (client-side first, then tell the server)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
SERVER (Script)                 CLIENTS (LocalScript)
─────────────────               ────────────────────
sees all players                sees own view only
authoritative                   guesses & displays
DataStores, HttpService         UI, camera, input
   ▲                                │
   └──────── remotes ───────────────┘
```
tips: Default to ServerScriptService for server scripts — clients can't even see them there
If a Script needs to talk to clients, use RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction via ReplicatedStorage
Server scripts start running as soon as their container loads — connect handlers early
commonMistakes: Putting authoritative logic in a LocalScript 'because it works in Studio' — clients can break or bypass it
Expecting Players.LocalPlayer in a Script — that's client-only (nil on server)
Forgetting a Script in StarterGui doesn't do what you think — StarterGui contents run as client context via LocalScripts; plain Scripts there are unusual and often a mistake

examples.title: A minimal authoritative Script
examples.code:
-- ServerScriptService/Main (Script)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    print(player.Name .. " joined (server knows first)")
end)

-- Server-side only APIs work here:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")   -- OK
-- game.Players.LocalPlayer would be nil here — server has no 'local player'
